content: JMGO’s 4K 120Hz Iris Ultra Max all-in-one Google TV projector is now available outside China. It gets its name from a new dual-iris system that lets it produce an impressive 10,000:1 native contrast, according to JMGO. It boosts the contrast — always an issue with projectors — by placing two separate physical apertures (irises) along different points of the internal optical path to control light scatter and brightness far more aggressively than a single iris can. It also promises to produce a very bright 6,500 ISO lumen image from its triple-laser light engine. Last year at IFA, 6,000 lumens from an all-in-one projector was breaking new ground. At IFA 2026, it’s shaping up to be table stakes, alongside 4k imagery purring along at a smooth 120Hz for fast-moving sports and gaming. Just note that I found JMGO’s N3 Ultimate to be unwatchable at peak brightness due to color distortion — so best wait for the reviews on this one.  Like that previous flagship, the new Iris Ultra Max is mounted on a motorized pan-and-tilt gimbal for useful Wiimote-like control. That, combined with an 0.88–1.7:1 optical zoom and V±130% / H±53% lens shift, gives you unparalleled image placement options that also preserve optical image quality.  [Image: A look around back. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/04-lRIS-Ultra-Max-Back_4.png?quality=90&strip=all] JGMO’s also tossing in VRR and ALLM to keep latency low and reduce tearing when gaming on the IRIS Ultra Max, with support for Dolby Vision HDR at 4K 120Hz. It will eventually list for $3,499, but that drops to $2,999 for preorders that begin today, ahead of an October 19th ship date.

chineseContent: 坚果 4K 120Hz Iris Ultra Max 一体式 Google TV 投影仪现已在中国境外上市。据坚果称，它的名字来源于一个新的双光圈系统，该系统可以产生令人印象深刻的 10,000:1 原始对比度。它通过沿着内部光路的不同点放置两个独立的物理光圈（虹膜）来提高对比度（这始终是投影仪的一个问题），以比单个虹膜更积极地控制光散射和亮度。它还承诺通过其三激光引擎产生非常明亮的 6,500 ISO 流明图像。去年在 IFA 上，一款 6,000 流明的一体式投影仪开创了新局面。在 IFA 2026 上，它与 4k 图像一起以流畅的 120Hz 的速度播放快速移动的体育和游戏，将成为赌注。请注意，我发现坚果 N3 Ultimate 在峰值亮度下由于颜色失真而无法观看 - 所以最好等待对此的评论。  与之前的旗舰产品一样，新款 Iris Ultra Max 安装在电动云台万向节上，可实现类似 Wiimote 的有用控制。再结合 0.88–1.7:1 光学变焦和 V±130% / H±53% 镜头移位，为您提供无与伦比的图像放置选项，同时保持光学图像质量。  [图片：回头看看。 https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/04-lRIS-Ultra-Max-Back_4.png?quality=90&strip=all] JGMO 还加入了 VRR 和 ALLM，以在 IRIS Ultra Max 上玩游戏时保持低延迟并减少撕裂，并支持 4K 120Hz 的杜比视界 HDR。它的最终售价为 3,499 美元，但从今天开始（即 10 月 19 日发货日期）开始预订，价格将降至 2,999 美元。
